dossiers.financial_spine: Regulated inter-state transmission monopoly (~85% GoI); earnings are CERC-tariffed annuity at 15.5% allowed RoE on commissioned assets plus cost pass-throughs — genuine and durable, not cyclical. FY26 was a mature grower: revenue ~flat, PAT +3% (Rs15,928cr), 5-yr sales CAGR ~3%. The over-rate is valuation + rate-proxy, NOT capex-hope being fake and NOT leverage: capex is genuinely re-accelerating and physically delivering (MVA +2.2x) but outruns capitalization (Rs82k vs Rs65k cr FY27-28) so the earnings payoff is deferred, while the stock's yield cushion has already compressed (3.1% vs 5.3% 5-yr avg). Composite ~60 is a mild over-rate; mid-50s reads truer; correct stance HOLD (trim-leaning).
dossiers.drivers: Regulated RoE (15.5%) compounding on a growing commissioned-asset/regulated-equity base; capex->capitalization conversion pace (FY26 capex Rs39,967cr beat guide, capitalization Rs28,200cr); RE-evacuation + HVDC (127GW/22 schemes) + green-H2/data-centre pipeline (>Rs15 lakh cr TAM); TBCB win share (~44%, Rs1.37 lakh cr in hand); dividend (~3.1% yield) + PGInvIT monetization optionality.
dossiers.dependencies: CERC 2024-29 tariff regime (15.5% RoE); TBCB competitive bidding (lower/uncertain IRRs, input-cost inflation, change-in-law recovery risk) vs a declining cost-plus RTM base; capex execution and capitalization lag; interest-rate/bond-yield sensitivity (yield play — de-rates as the 10-yr G-Sec rises); ~85% govt ownership/OFS overhang; pace of India's RE build-out.
dossiers.forensics: REGULATED-UTILITY scan: EBITDA margin structurally ~85-89% (Q3FY26 85.95%); the optically weak FY26/Q4 ~75% is a ONE-OFF (Regulatory Deferral Account move -Rs2,823cr from forex + deferred-tax remeasurement post Finance Act 2026), NOT a structural break. Net debt ~Rs1.48 lakh cr, net-debt/EBITDA ~3.5x, D/E 60:40 — NORMAL and HEALTHY for a regulated utility (tariff formula assumes 70:30 gearing); AAA-rated, ~3.8x interest cover: leverage is a NON-ISSUE, do not flag. Watch-item is capex outrunning capitalization. RoNW softened FY26 (16.75%->15.85% consol). Valuation FULL: P/B ~2.6x (book Rs108), P/E ~16x for ~3% growth; as a bond-proxy the ~3.1% yield vs ~6.8% rising G-Sec argues against further multiple expansion. Earnings base GENUINE — no accounting red flags; the caution is price + rate-proxy only.

valuation.method: P/B x sustainable regulated RoE (2.35-2.65x on Rs108 book, ~15.9% RoNW) cross-checked vs DDM/yield (~3.1%) and capex-growth optionality; bear floor ~2.0x=Rs216-230, bull ~2.9-3.0x/consensus=Rs315-360

dossiers.prediction: Base: trades in line-to-slightly-lagging Nifty over 30/60/90d, range ~Rs270-300 (low-beta yield compounder, paused rates). Rate trigger / hard falsifier: if India 10-yr G-Sec pushes decisively >7.0% (from ~6.78%), expect UNDERPERFORM vs Nifty by 3-6% (bond-proxy de-rate) -> confirms trim. Bull-flip falsifier: FY27 capitalization run-rate >=Rs30k cr AND standalone PAT growth >8% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters, OR yield re-expands toward ~4%+ on price weakness -> upgrade to buy.

dossiers.financial_spine: India's national reinsurer (~77-82% govt-owned) with a thin 4% obligatory-cession moat that is eroding. FLOAT-profitable, NOT underwriting-profitable: FY26 combined ratio 106.02% (>100% = underwriting loss Rs1,763cr) and essentially 100% of PAT (Rs8,392cr std / Rs9,662cr consol) comes from Rs13,089cr investment income. The over-rate is primarily a value/value-trap question, not a quality one: the huge investment book (~Rs1.48L cr) carries ~Rs45,000cr of unrealized (mostly equity) gains that sit OUTSIDE stated book — more than the entire stated net worth — so most of the real value IS the investment float, and the stock trades ~0.45x that economic book. Live 'buy' should down-rate to a value/asset-backed HOLD (accumulate-on-weakness); composite ~63 is fair-to-slightly-generous.
dossiers.drivers: Genuine multi-year underwriting turnaround (CR 114%->106%, UW loss halved YoY, Q4FY26 an actual UW profit, profitable in all segments bar Motor/Life); massive investment float + ~Rs45k cr unrealized equity gains; large domestic obligatory + voluntary cession base; investment income Rs13,089cr as the sole profit engine; premium growing again (+7% GPW, international no longer shrinking).
dossiers.dependencies: Combined-ratio/underwriting discipline; nat-cat & crop (PMFBY) loss volatility; equity-market level (float + fair-value reserve mark); IRDAI solvency/obligatory-cession rules (4%); the now-SOFTENING international reinsurance pricing cycle; govt ownership + OFS supply overhang (77.4%, MPS gap 2.4%).
dossiers.forensics: Combined ratio 106.02% FY26 (108.81% FY25, ~114% FY19) = STILL an underwriting LOSS but improving; incurred-claims ratio 85.40%; the 'adjusted CR 84.79%' only turns profitable by crediting float income. PAT is ~100% investment-driven (invest income Rs13,089cr vs UW loss Rs1,763cr), so earnings quality is market-dependent, flattered by equity gains. Solvency 4.21x (IRDAI min 1.5x) — fortress. Investment book ~Rs1.48L cr; unrealized-gain (fair-value-change) reserve ~Rs45k cr > stated net worth (~Rs51k cr) => P/B ~0.90x on stated book but ~0.45x on economic book incl. gains = genuinely cheap WITH asset backing, not a bare value trap. Premium +7% (shrink-by-design phase over). ROE ~13.6-14.6%. Domestic share eroded 74%->51%. net_debt/EBITDA NOT meaningful (reinsurer, debt-free, float-levered).

valuation.method: P/B x sustainable ~13-14% ROE (1.0-1.2x stated book Rs402) cross-checked on economic book incl. ~Rs45k cr unrealized gains (~0.85-0.95x of ~Rs490-510/sh) and a ~2.7% div-yield floor

dossiers.prediction: 30/60/90d: range-bound to modestly out-perform Nifty (-3% to +8% over 90d); Rs350 OFS-floor/52wk-low as support, Rs390-400 OFS-overhang resistance. FALSIFIER (any one): combined ratio backs up ABOVE ~108% (cat/crop/soft-cycle), OR a >10% equity-market drawdown hits the float/fair-value reserve, OR a fresh OFS tranche announced -> breaks Rs350 and underperforms Nifty by >8% over 60-90d.

dossiers.financial_spine: Govt-owned power/infra-financier NBFC (IFC); PFC owns ~52.6% and is now ABSORBING REC via an 88:100 share swap (target Apr-2027) — RECLTD is on a path to delist into PFC, which CAPS standalone upside. FY26 record PAT Rs16,282cr but Q4 PAT fell ~21% YoY on NIM compression + forex-hedge/OCI losses (margin-driven, NOT credit). Asset-quality clean-up is durable/real (GNPA 9.11%->2.55%, NNPA ~0.12%, Stage-2 -75% YoY, PCR ~77%, impairment -80%), so the over-rate is NOT asset-quality and NOT valuation (cheap at 1.1x book / 5.7x PE / 20% ROE); the only genuine over-rate legs are NIM/rate-sensitivity and the merger cap on re-rating. Live 'buy' is COHERENT (capped merger-arb + cheap yield), composite ~67 roughly fair.
dossiers.drivers: Underlying AUM growth ~16% ex-Rs49,000cr prepayments (reported book only +3% due to Kaleshwaram + RVPF surplus-cash prepayments); disbursements Rs2.11L cr (+10%; +28% ex-RDSS), sanctions +21%; RE book +30% to Rs75,347cr (~13% of book); ROA ~2.7%, ROE ~20%, NIM ~3.4%; very low cost-to-income (IFC-typical).
dossiers.dependencies: Discom/distribution concentration (~40% of book, ~69% of disbursements) + a govt discom-restructuring package under discussion; cost of funds ~7.1% and RISING (bonds/54EC/foreign borrowings -> rate & FX-hedge sensitivity, ~5% dividend-yield proxy); RBI project-finance norms (final = SOFTER, prov 5%->1% = tailwind, overhang released); RE + airports/metros/healthcare diversification adds unfamiliar credit risk (growth-quality watch); PFC-group/GoI ownership + the 88:100 PFC merger as the dominant swing factor.
dossiers.forensics: NBFC-correct: GNPA ~2.55% (from 9.11% FY21), NNPA ~0.12%, PCR ~77%, Stage-2 -75% YoY (durability confirmed), credit cost/impairment Rs201cr vs Rs1,019cr FY25; CRAR ~23.1% (Tier-1 comfortable); NIM ~3.4% (down from 3.74% Q1, compressing - watch), spread ~2.62%, yield ~10.1% vs CoF ~7.1%; ROA ~2.7%, ROE ~20%; loan book Rs5.84L cr; dividend yield ~5.1%. High leverage + negative OCF are EXPECTED for a growing lender (NOT flags). RBI project-finance-norm overhang RELEASED softer (tailwind). Valuation P/B ~1.1x on 20% ROE = cheap (~half peer ~2.1x). Asset-quality clean-up verified durable, not cosmetic. CORPORATE ACTION: pending merger into PFC (88:100 swap, President-approved 10-Jun-2026, boards 28-Jun-2026, completion ~1-Apr-2027) => treat as a PFC-swap proxy, not an independent large-cap.

valuation.method: P/B ~1.20-1.45x x sustainable ROE ~18-20%, cross-checked vs PE ~6.5-7.5x and ~5.1% dividend yield; HIGH end capped because REC=0.88x PFC via the 88:100 merger swap (only ~2-4% premium) so standalone re-rating is largely foreclosed; consensus avg ~Rs440 sits mid-band

dossiers.prediction: Tracks PFC as a converging merger-arb; performs broadly in line to modestly ahead of Nifty over 30/60/90d (cushioned by ~5% yield), range ~Rs330-400. Hard falsifiers: (1) GNPA back above ~3% or fresh discom/genco Stage-3 slippage (esp. an NPV haircut from the discom-restructuring package); (2) NIM prints below ~3.2% or another large hedge/OCI loss; (3) the 88:100 swap re-termed adversely, delayed past Apr-2027, or blocked; (4) a rate back-up de-rates the yield proxy and RECLTD underperforms Nifty by >7-8%.
